sql: SELECT o.id, o.market_ticker t, to_char(o.created_at,'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') c, o.status s, o.side sd, o.limit_price p, o.quantity q, left(coalesce(o.cancel_reason,''),28) r, to_char((SELECT max(e.received_at) FROM execution_order_events e WHERE e.kalshi_order_id=o.kalshi_order_id AND e.status IN ('canceled','executed')),'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') ee, to_char((SELECT max(q.captured_at) FROM live_order_queue_ticks q WHERE q.live_order_id=o.id),'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') lt, (SELECT coalesce(sum(f.quantity),0) FROM fills f WHERE f.kalshi_order_id=o.kalshi_order_id) fq FROM live_orders o WHERE o.strategy='Alimm1' AND o.action='buy' AND o.client_order_id NOT LIKE 'limmexit%' AND o.client_order_id NOT LIKE 'limmsell:%' AND o.id > 7554 ORDER BY o.id LIMIT 200
